title: Background values
description: The file game/tuning/background.json: how the background moves and glows, read in both run modes. The file must exist; every field is optional, and a field left out keeps its default from game/app/background_tuning.py (DEFAULTS). {} is a valid file. All defaults are guesses (12-art-and-audio.md, background_numbers); tune them after a frame-rate check in the browser build. Loaded and checked by game/app/background_tuning.py at startup into ui.background_view.BackgroundRules. Look only: no field changes play. Owner of the schema: architect.

sway_loop_ticks.description: Ticks the far painting's sway takes for one full loop. The painting is a loop of baked frames; the game fades from one to the next over this time.

planet_count.description: Broken planets on screen at once. 0 shows none.

planet_speed.description: Px a planet moves straight down per tick.

planet_scale.description: Planet size against the shipped sprite (about 100 px). 1 is as shipped.

river_light_count.description: River light specks at most, the cap. 0 shows none.

river_light_loop_ticks.description: Ticks a river speck takes from its start to the black hole. Also the length of the river's loop.

river_light_strength.description: Brightness of river light and the swirl, 0 (off) to 1 (full).

swirl_count.description: Specks circling the black hole. 0 shows none.

swirl_loop_ticks.description: Ticks the swirl takes for one full turn.

glow_height.description: Height of the fuchsia glow along the bottom edge, px. 0 turns it off.

glow_strength.description: Brightness of the bottom glow at the very bottom edge, 0 (off) to 1 (full).
